page.title: Pebble Trays Lab
page.heading: Pebble Trays
page.subtitle: Original for this book · CC BY 4.0 · Hold marks · follow the list · write the result
guide.heading: Guided beat
guide.ready.body: Keep marks in the trays. Reveal one recipe step at a time and do only that step. When the list ends, copy how many marks sit in the last tray onto the strip.
answer.label: Answer strip — copy the count from the last tray
note: A shared practice for the “what is this kind of machine?” pages — the same lab in every language of the book.
recipe.1: Put three pebbles in the first tray.
recipe.2: Put two pebbles in the middle tray.
recipe.3: Move every pebble from the first tray into the last tray.
recipe.4: Move every pebble from the middle tray into the last tray.
recipe.5: Look at the last tray. Copy that count onto the answer strip.
recipe.facedown_html: The card is face-down. Press Show next step to reveal the first line only.
recipe.done: List finished. Copy the last tray onto the strip.
live.moved.one: Moved {n} pebble into the last tray.
live.moved.other: Moved {n} pebbles into the last tray.
guide.step.body: Do only this step. Use +1 / −1 on the trays. Do not skip ahead.
guide.write.body: Copy how many pebbles sit in the last tray onto the answer strip.
check.bad: Does not match the last tray yet — count again.
